title: Fractal Tree Generator with Dynamic Difficulty
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with an interactive 3D fractal tree generator using Three.js. The scene features a procedurally generated fractal tree that grows from the ground, with a parrot (Parrot.glb) perched on one of the branches. Users can control the tree's recursion depth (difficulty) and other parameters.

## Scene Setup
- Use a perspective camera at position (0, 8, 20) looking at (0, 5, 0).
- Add a dark gradient sky background (use scene.background with a Color of 0x1a1a2e).
- Add ambient light (0x404060, intensity 0.5) and a directional light (0xffeedd, intensity 1.0) at position (10, 20, 10) with castShadow enabled.
- Add a ground plane (50x50, color 0x2d5a27) at y=0 with receiveShadow.
- Enable OrbitControls for camera rotation.
- Enable shadow mapping on the renderer.

## Fractal Tree Generation
- The tree starts at position (0, 0, 0) growing upward along Y axis.
- Use cylinder geometries for branches (brown 0x8B4513 material).
- Each branch splits into 2-3 child branches at its tip, rotated by a spread angle.
- The trunk starts with radius 0.5 and length 4.0.
- Each recursion level reduces branch length by factor 0.7 and radius by factor 0.6.
- Branch spread angle is 30 degrees by default.
- Add leaf spheres (green 0x228B22, radius 0.3) at terminal branches.
- Initial recursion depth is 3.

## Parrot Model
- Load 'Parrot.glb' using GLTFLoader from Three.js examples (use CDN: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.163.0/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js).
- Place the parrot on the tip of the highest branch of the tree.
- Scale the parrot to (0.03, 0.03, 0.03).
- If the model has animations, play the first animation using an AnimationMixer.
- The parrot should update its position whenever the tree is regenerated.

## UI Controls (DOM Elements)
- Create a control panel div (id='controlPanel') at top-left with semi-transparent dark background.
- Add a label showing 'Recursion Depth: X' (id='depthLabel').
- Add '+' button (id='btnIncreaseDepth') and '-' button (id='btnDecreaseDepth') to change depth (min 1, max 7).
- Add a label showing 'Spread Angle: Xdeg' (id='angleLabel').
- Add '+' button (id='btnIncreaseAngle') and '-' button (id='btnDecreaseAngle') to change spread angle by 5 degrees (min 10, max 60).
- Add a 'Toggle Leaves' button (id='btnToggleLeaves') that shows/hides leaf spheres.
- Add a 'Randomize Colors' button (id='btnRandomize') that assigns random hue colors to branches.
- Add a 'Reset' button (id='btnReset') that resets all parameters to defaults.
- Add a display showing total branch count (id='branchCount').

## Keyboard Controls
- Press 'ArrowUp' to increase recursion depth (same as + button).
- Press 'ArrowDown' to decrease recursion depth (same as - button).
- Press 'L' to toggle leaves.
- Press 'R' to reset.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- recursionDepth: current depth (number, initially 3)
- spreadAngle: current angle in degrees (number, initially 30)
- totalBranches: total number of branch segments (number)
- totalLeaves: total number of leaf objects (number)
- leavesVisible: boolean (initially true)
- parrotLoaded: boolean (false until model loads)
- parrotPosition: {x, y, z} of parrot's current world position
- colorsRandomized: boolean (initially false)
- treeHeight: approximate height of the tallest point of the tree (number)
- isAnimating: boolean (true if parrot animation is playing)

Update __3D_STATE__ every frame in the animation loop and after every parameter change. When the tree is regenerated, recount branches and leaves, recalculate tree height, and reposition the parrot.
physics_constraints: Tree geometry must follow fractal rules: each level reduces length by 0.7 and radius by 0.6. Branch count follows the formula based on branching factor and depth. Tree height must be consistent with the sum of branch lengths along the tallest path. Parrot must always be positioned at or near the highest branch tip.
